preconditions.description: The number of rows and columns must be between 2 and 300.

preconditions.expression: all(len(cell) > 0 for row in initial_state for cell in row)
preconditions.description: All cells in the initial state must be non-empty strings.

preconditions.expression: sum(len(cell) for row in initial_state for cell in row) <= 100000
preconditions.description: The total length of strings in the initial state must not exceed 100,000.

preconditions.expression: sum(cell.count('0') for row in initial_state for cell in row) == sum(cell.count('0') for row in final_state for cell in row)
preconditions.description: The number of zeros in the initial and final states must be the same.

preconditions.expression: sum(cell.count('1') for row in initial_state for cell in row) == sum(cell.count('1') for row in final_state for cell in row)
preconditions.description: The number of ones in the initial and final states must be the same.

postconditions.description: The number of operations used must be between 0 and 4 times the total length of strings in the initial state.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= x1 <= n and 1 <= y1 <= m and 1 <= x2 <= n and 1 <= y2 <= m for x1, y1, x2, y2 in operations)
postconditions.description: All operations must involve valid cell indices within the table.

postconditions.expression: all((x1, y1) != (x2, y2) for x1, y1, x2, y2 in operations)
postconditions.description: No operation can involve the same cell for both source and destination.

postconditions.expression: all((x1 == x2 or y1 == y2) for x1, y1, x2, y2 in operations)
postconditions.description: Operations must involve cells in the same row or column.

postconditions.expression: all(len(initial_state[x1-1][y1-1]) > 0 for x1, y1, x2, y2 in operations)
postconditions.description: The source cell in each operation must be non-empty.
